subject: Exec approval request: Aurora bundled support + integration scope
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Exec approval request: Aurora bundled support + integration scope

Team —

Quick background: Aurora Analytics is a strategic mid-market prospect (expected first-year ARR ~$420k) negotiating a contract where they want:
- Premium Support (24x7 SLA) included for the first 12 months at no incremental charge
- Our standard onboarding package expanded to cover a custom Snowflake <> Aurora connector (estimated 6-week integration scope)
- Requesting an 18% one-time discount off list for year one to land the deal this quarter

Attachments: Aurora_SOW_Draft_v2.docx (SOW with integration milestones), Aurora_PRICING_Summary.xlsx (price and margin calc). Aurora also sent an internal PO this morning which I’ve attached below.

Why escalate: Sales Ops flagged margin erosion and the inclusion of Premium Support + custom integration are outside standard deal guardrails. Deal desk can approve up to 15% discount; 18% + the bundled services needs an exec exception. If we close in May it closes Q2 for the rep.

Ask: Exec approval to accept the following commercial package:
- 12-month committed term, billed annually
- One-time discount: 18% year-one list price
- Include Premium Support (first 12 months) at no additional recurring charge
- Fixed-fee SOW for integration: $48,000 billed 50/50 (50% upfront, 50% on acceptance)

Conditions I recommend: acceptance criteria in SOW, 2-week formal acceptance testing window, and standard data residency clause (US region).

If approved, I’ll update the quote and ask Legal to finalize the limited amendment for the premium support inclusion. Need a decision by EOD 2026-04-30 to keep momentum.

Thanks —
Karthik
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Karthik —

Thanks for the context and the attachments. A couple fast clarifying questions before I escalate:
1) Can you confirm the expected first-year net ARR after discount and implementation fees (so I can model quota credit)?
2) Does the integration SOW include post-implementation support hours or are those handled under Premium Support? We need to avoid double-billing.
3) Are there any non-standard termination or data-handling terms from Aurora (they sometimes push for extended data retention and audit rights).

If the numbers show material margin hit I’ll want Marissa’s read; if not I’ll route to Vivek for an exception.

-Lauren
Head of Sales Ops

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-28T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec approval request: Aurora bundled support + integration scope

Looping in the deal math I ran this morning (see Aurora_PRICING_Summary.xlsx). TL;DR:
- List ARR (year 1) pre-discount: $512,000
- 18% one-time discount reduces billed ARR to $419,840 (–$92,160)
- Integration SOW ($48,000) is professional services revenue; estimated billable margin ~60% after implementation resource costs
- Premium Support cost differential (first 12 months): estimated additional cost to us ~$22,000 (on-call uplift + priority SLA staffing)

Net impact: expected gross margin compression ~11% on year-one revenue vs standard deals. That’s material but not fatal.

Deal desk policy: approval at 15% discount and standard SOW terms can be signed by Sales Ops. Anything above 15% requires exec approval. If exec approves the 18% discount I recommend the following guardrails:
- Premium Support inclusion limited to 12 months explicitly (auto-converts to paid after term unless they opt out)
- SOW must include milestone-based payments and explicit acceptance criteria tied to the final invoice
- Finance to treat the one-time discount via an approved customer credit memo rather than altering list prices (for reporting clarity)

If you want I can prepare the amendment and updated net revenue schedule for Finance to pre-approve the credit path.

Marissa
Senior Deal Desk Manager | Redwood Inference

From: James Lee <j.lee@aurora-analytics.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, procurement@aurora-analytics.com
Cc: procurement@aurora-analytics.com
Date: 2026-04-28T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal and SOW — Aurora x Redwood (PO attached)

Karthik —

Thanks for the SOW and price summary. Procurement is ready to move if we can agree on the package below: 18% discount for year one, Premium Support included for 12 months, and the integration work completed under the attached SOW (PO attached: Aurora_PO_0428.pdf). We need final confirmation by May 3 to meet our internal vendor onboarding window.

Important to note: our security team wants the connector deployment to remain in our US region tenant and that audit logs be retained for 13 months. We don’t ask for special rights beyond standard SOC2 compliance.

Looking forward to finalizing.

Regards,
James Lee
Head of Data Integrations | Aurora Analytics

Date: 2026-04-28T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec approval request: Aurora bundled support + integration scope

Team —

Reviewed the thread and Marissa’s margin notes. Given strategic value and probability to close this quarter, I’m willing to approve an exception with the following explicit conditions:
1) Discount: approve up to 17.5% (not to exceed). If the rep needs 18% for relationship reasons, Sales should absorb the incremental 0.5% via a pipeline adjustment (quota relief) rather than changing company pricebook.
2) Premium Support: approve inclusion for first 12 months only. After 12 months, customer is charged standard Premium Support rates unless they sign an extension.
3) SOW & Acceptance: SOW must include milestone-based payments, formal acceptance criteria, and a 2-week acceptance testing window before final invoice.
4) Security/Data: honor Aurora’s request for US-region deployment and 13-month audit log retention. Legal to confirm there are no additional non-standard audit rights.
5) Finance: Marissa/Finance to issue the one-time discount as a customer credit memo for proper reporting.

If we’re aligned on the above, Karthik: go ahead and send the updated quote and amendment. Lauren/Marissa, please finalize the paperwork and loop Legal for the Premium Support amendment.

Approved.

Vivek
VP, Commercial | Redwood Inference
